short_description: A rhyming hardcover read-aloud for ages 2–6 about grandparents' laps, bus laps, song laps and sleepy laps, with a grown-up talk tip on every spread.
long_description:
Laps Not Apps is a warm, rhyming read-aloud about the best seats in town: the laps that hold our littlest listeners close.

A toddler sets off to find the day's laps: Dad's armchair (his phone resting face-down), Grandma's lap with the very best wheels, a high-up lap on the bus, a big brother's cross-legged 'nest' for singing, a park full of laps with friends Ada, Mama Jo, Mama Bea and the baby, a blanket fort on a rainy afternoon, and a slow, rocking lap when the moon comes up.

The gentle couplets are made for reading out loud. They are full of sounds to share (a ROAR, a squeak, a QUACK), things to count and point to, and places to pause. Every spread includes a short Lap talk idea for grown-ups: wait before you turn the page, say what you see and add one word, offer a choice, or stop before the fun word so your child can fill it in.

The end pages include 5 lap games for tiny ones, each with plain safety notes, plus keepsake pages to fill in: This book belongs to, A lap-story gift from, and Our favorite laps.

The cast is diverse and modern, including a grandmother who uses a wheelchair, and it's drawn in a bold, flat, friendly style. This sturdy hardcover makes a heartfelt baby-shower gift.

compliance_notes: No health or medical claims: the book is parent education and a story, not a clinical service, and it claims to treat, prevent or diagnose nothing. Not presented as written by a speech-language pathologist or any clinician. Talk strategies use plain words only, with no trademarked program names. No real brands, logos, apps, schools or products: the only screen is a generic phone resting face-down on a side table on the first spread, drawn as a neutral object. No research citations are used. Child safety: every lap game is framed with adult supervision and includes a safety line. The safety box covers the small-parts rule for under-3s (toilet-paper-tube test, about 1.25 in / 3.2 cm), no balloons, no cords or strings, car seats (never a lap in a car), moving a sleeping baby to their own safe sleep space on their back, and stopping when the child says no. 'Row the Boat' warns never to pull, swing or lift a child by the arms. The songs and rhymes referenced (trot-trot knee bounce, rowing song, toe counting) are traditional and generic. The copyright page reads '© 2026 AlphaPlay LLC. Play Before Pixels is a trade name of AlphaPlay LLC.' and uses the business mailbox address, not a home address. The print PDFs are RGB with 0.125 in bleed on all sides.
